title: Character Sheet moves off Krea2 onto a Klein 4B / 9B model selector
description: Fabio, 2026-08-23 (CORRECTED - the original card text was wrong): the Character Sheet adopts the TWO-SLOT shape Scribble to Object ships - a Render model dropdown (krea2 / krea2-nsfw, the generation phase, UNCHANGED) and a Blend model dropdown (klein-4b / klein-9b, the head-removal phase, today hardcoded to 4B). NO Krea 2 machinery is removed. Both phases get their own six LoRAs. Runs AFTER MPI-608, whose per-phase rack mechanism this consumes and which holds js/data/flowsRegistry.js.
